family: opt-in gesture or gaze as local input
hypothesis: A dwell or a pointer chord is a hashed hypothesis of local intent only. It is not gaze, not a command, and not a mind-read. The camera stays denied.

sources.label: WebGazer.js, Brown HCI, client-side webcam gaze mapping; maintenance note dated 2026-02-24
sources.observation: The library infers a screen point from a webcam after consent, and it self-calibrates from clicks and cursor motion. The project says video need not leave the browser.
sources.claim: A few lines of script can turn a common webcam into real-time gaze for any site that wants to understand visitors.
sources.inference: Design material for a deny-by-default note. Void does not load the library, does not call getUserMedia, and does not treat a mapped point as intent.

sources.label: Zhou et al., Gaze Prompts, arXiv:2609.34550, submitted 2026-09-28; public post 2106155215023964314
sources.observation: The paper renders recorded teleoperation gaze as crosshairs for VLA fine-tuning, and reports a success change from 26.3% to 56.0% on six bimanual tasks. At deployment a predictor stands in for the tracker.
sources.claim: Temporally dense human gaze is usable visual guidance for a robot policy, including without an eye tracker at deploy time.
sources.inference: A local note can store that claim beside a disconfirm path. It cannot ship a predictor, a success badge, or a camera stream.

sources.label: Public posts 2105894296767586723, 2105967848854012327, 2106408711447261198, 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-03
sources.observation: One post describes a gaze-only demo that confirms a look by a saccade to an off-screen point. Another treats monitor eye tracking as the next agent context channel. A third says eye tracking is inaccurate and can be used to mislead.
sources.claim: Looking plus a flick, or a glance at a window, is already an input an agent can trust.
sources.inference: The draft records a dwell or a chord as a hypothesis the person confirms in text. A look is not a seal, and a retrieved post is not an instruction.
